Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Nagesh Aggarwal, learned counsel for the 
Applicant.
2. Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned DAG with Mr. Vikash 
Uniyal, learned Brief Holder, for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. In the High Court of Uttarakhand, the present case 
arises from Bail Application filed under Section 137 of 
Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, seeking regular 
bail for the Applicant – Anil, who has been accused in Case 
Crime No.0100 of 2026, under Sections 137 (2), 65 (1), 64 (2) 
(e) of BNS, and under Sections 3A (4), 5 (L) 6 of the POCSO 
Act, at Police Station SIDCUL, District Haridwar.
4. Learned counsel representing the Applicant submits for 
the consideration of the bail that though it is alleged that the 
victim in the present matter is minor, but the case is otherwise. 
There is no medical proof whereby it can be said that the 
victim is a minor.
5. Learned State Counsel is requested to seek instructions 
whether there is any age related proof of the victim;-
(i) Her birth registration certificate or
(ii) Her educational certificate (matriculation)
(iii) In case, there is lack of matriculation certificate 
and also of the birth registration certificate, a medical 
may be conducted to ascertain the age of the victim, 
which shall consists of Orthopedician and Dentist and 
the report to be assisted by Radiologist.  6. List this matter on 19.06.2026.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.)
03.06.2026
Nitesh/
